mapper.sql: id, company_id, topic, advice_md, llm_used, confidence, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_insight_advice ( company_id, topic, advice_md, llm_used, confidence, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{topic}, #{adviceMd}, #{llmUsed}, #{confidence}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opc_insight_advice WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND topic = #{topic} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
